"""Reproduce ticket: in_bulk() on a field unique via UniqueConstraint."""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": ":memory:"}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth"],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD="django.db.models.AutoField",
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection


class Article(models.Model):
    slug = models.CharField(max_length=255)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "contenttypes"
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["slug"], name="%(app_label)s_%(class)s_slug_unq"
            )
        ]


class Conditional(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=255)

    class Meta:
        app_label = "contenttypes"
        required_db_features = {"supports_partial_indexes"}
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=["name"], name="cond_name_unq", condition=models.Q(name__gt="")
            )
        ]


with connection.schema_editor() as editor:
    editor.create_model(Article)
    editor.create_model(Conditional)

a1 = Article.objects.create(slug="one")
a2 = Article.objects.create(slug="two")

# The exact call from the ticket:
result = Article.objects.in_bulk(field_name="slug")
assert result == {"one": a1, "two": a2}, result
print("OK: in_bulk(field_name='slug') on UniqueConstraint field ->", result)

# With an id_list too:
result = Article.objects.in_bulk(["one"], field_name="slug")
assert result == {"one": a1}, result
print("OK: in_bulk(['one'], field_name='slug') ->", result)

# Non-unique field must still raise:
try:
    Article.objects.in_bulk(field_name="pk")  # pk is fine
except ValueError:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: pk should be allowed")
try:
    Article.objects.in_bulk([1], field_name="slug")
except ValueError as e:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: slug should be allowed: %s" % e)

# Conditional (partial) constraint must NOT count as unique:
try:
    Conditional.objects.in_bulk(field_name="name")
except ValueError:
    print("OK: conditional UniqueConstraint still rejected")
else:
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: conditional constraint must not be accepted")

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
